dialogues.speaker: Pochtli
dialogues.text: You were really throwing some shapes up on that stage! I've never seen someone dance with such power before... It was epic! Can you show us again?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Joints cooling... Please try again later...

dialogues.speaker: Tano
dialogues.text: Was that... "the robot"? I thought that dance was the stuff of legends...
